_marker: CHILD-WIDER-THAN-PARENT BASELINE — a committed per-library defect count that may only DECREASE. `overflows` counts in-flow children wider than their parent with a non-text cause; `textCaused` counts the exempted class (the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap, docs/22) separately so it can never flatter the first number. Both ratchet TWO-SIDED: an increase is a new defect, a decrease is a fix that must be re-recorded here with its cause named. Re-record deliberately with `node scripts/child-wider.mjs --write` and say what moved.

rows.cause: textCaused(33): the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22 §"Text wrapping is not implemented") — grew 6→33 at the exact-conversion wave (feat/exact-conversion-wave0): Banner's promoted title/description rows, TextInput's label/helper runs and the source-geometry Slider labels are real hugging text runs the earlier harness-floor geometry hid. The five ProgressBar percent-width overflows the previous baseline named are FIXED — the wave carries the fill as a source-derived literal inside the track — so the non-text class is ZERO.

textCaused(8): all eight are the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap in Accordion (docs/22). Carbon's NON-text overflows were closed by the live-defect round (9c30204, D3) and its own compile receipt keeps a HARD zero on them — this row is the exempted class only.

overflows(18) — EXPLAINED, two causes, neither blind-recorded. 16 of 18 are ONE defect repeated once per variant: Checkbox's `indicator > icon` part is an `element: "svg"` promoted from the computed floor with NO asset and NO intrinsic size (examples/fluent/assets/icons/ ships only dialog-part-0-1-0.svg and switch-indicator.svg — there is no checkbox glyph), so the mock gives it its default 100px inside a 16px indicator, +84 every time. Same class the shadcn row already names for Tooltip's lucide polygon: an svg part with no resolvable asset ships as an unsized box. The remaining 2 are Switch's `label` at 66px inside a 59px parent (+7), ONLY on the two `Label Position=Above` cells, where the stacked layout gives the label a narrower column than its own hug width. textCaused(32) and marginBox(43) are the corpus-wide exempt classes (docs/22), counted separately and never folded into the number above.

overflows(2): Wave 5 denominator — `label` paints 75px inside a 74px Size=Medium/Small hug cell (Size=Medium + Size=Small). textCaused(56): corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22) — grew 14→56 at the exact-conversion wave landing, when MUI's scripts were finally re-emitted against the wave engine (they had sat stale; the freshness gate is what caught it): the non-truncating-text HUG rule (Carbon Tabs fix, refined by FC-TEXT-FILL-ALIGNMENT so alignment-displaced text still FILLs) makes hugging label runs measurable where the old FILL lowering masked them. Attribution: link +42 (one hugging label run per variant of the 42-variant set), text-field +6, accordion +4 (AccordionDetails body remains the canonical case), autocomplete +2, select +2. marginBox(2): Autocomplete POPUP indicator margin-right -2 (unchanged from task-#38).

marginBox(58): every one is a NEGATIVE-MARGIN paint-outside, not an overflow — the margin-box wrapper reserves less layout space than its child paints, which is what a negative margin is for. 42→58 at the exact-conversion wave: the checkbox/radio-button canvas-geometry rework (literal border+fill replacing the inset box-shadow tokens, per the console-loop visual fix) added 16 wrappers of the same class. Polaris keeps ZERO real child-wider overflows. textCaused(26): the corpus-wide text-wrapping gap (docs/22), 29→26 — three runs stopped overflowing under the wave's geometry edits; the wrapping fix remains its own corpus-wide round.

INSTRUMENT-GAP NAMED, NOT EXPLOITED: the per-component compile-receipt run (fresh mock per script) witnessed ONE real overflow this row does not carry — Tooltip's arrow "part-0-0-0-0" (a lucide <polygon>) at the mock's default 100px inside its 10px icon frame. Root cause is the svg-asset v1 grammar (path/g/circle; polygon refused by name → svg-child-outside-grammar), so the arrow ships as an unsized box part. countChildWider scans set-parented cells whenever ANY COMPONENT_SET exists in the mock, and shadcn's Tooltip builds as a STANDALONE component beside 8 sets — structurally outside this instrument's denominator. Widening the scan moves every library's committed number (standalone components exist corpus-wide) and is its own instrument round; until then this row's zero UNDERSTATES by exactly that one named overflow. See examples/shadcn/PROVENANCE.md.
